fchub-p24.name: Przelewy24
fchub-p24.description: Przelewy24 payment gateway for FluentCart, built for the Polish market. Handles checkout, IPN callbacks, and refunds so nobody has to explain BLIK to a support ticket.

fchub-fakturownia.name: Fakturownia
fchub-fakturownia.description: Invoice automation with Fakturownia and KSeF 2.0 for FluentCart orders. Generates, sends, and tracks invoices automatically, including real-time submission to the tax office.

fchub-memberships.name: Memberships
fchub-memberships.description: A complete membership system for FluentCart: plans, access rules, and drip content. Grants and revokes access automatically as subscriptions change, so nobody keeps access they stopped paying for.

fchub-portal-extender.name: Portal Extender
fchub-portal-extender.description: Build custom customer portal pages for FluentCart without writing PHP. Add your own sections and layouts through a visual admin screen.

fchub-wishlist.name: Wishlist
fchub-wishlist.description: Wishlists for FluentCart shoppers. Lets customers save products for later instead of abandoning their cart in despair.

fchub-multi-currency.name: Multi-Currency
fchub-multi-currency.description: Automatic currency conversion for FluentCart storefronts. Shows prices in the customer's local currency, so pricing complaints arrive in more languages.
